notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for rejecting resignation while an ownership acquisition is pending. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies the standard pending-acquisition resignation failure, continued membership, cancellation cleanup, and ownership preservation without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attribute ownership acquisition and resignation action boundary with FederateAmbassador ownership callbacks
